scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Electricity Duty
other_conditions: The unit must have started production on or after 1 April 2022
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector or owned/managed by the State Government
The scheme shall not be applicable to certain industrial units/enterprises as specified by the authorities
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
benefits_summary: 100% waiver of electricity duty for up to ₹1,00,00,000 per year for a period of five years from the date of commencement of production.
documents_required: Eligibility Certificate issued by the Director of Textiles
